endpoints.description: Near-Earth Object approaches in a date range

limits.notes: With key: 1,000 requests/hour per key. DEMO_KEY allows 30/hour, 50/day. Uses api.data.gov infrastructure; rate-limit info in response headers.

llmDocs.summary: Family of NASA APIs: APOD, Near-Earth Objects (asteroids), DONKI space weather, Mars rover photos, EPIC/Earth imagery, exoplanet archive. Single api_key across most.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Pass api_key on every call. Each sub-API has its own path and params. NEO feed needs start_date/end_date (max 7-day span). Use DEMO_KEY only for trivial testing.
gotchas: NEO feed limits the date range to 7 days per request.
DEMO_KEY is heavily throttled (50/day) — get a real key for anything real.
Some sub-APIs (e.g. exoplanet archive, some imagery) live on different hosts despite sharing the key.

compliance.redistributionNotes: Most NASA media/data is public domain (NASA media usage guidelines apply); some third-party imagery embedded in NASA products may carry restrictions.
